guide.title: Rental Guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to know, even if it is your first time.
process: Message us on Instagram or call with the dress, your size, and your competition or show date.
We confirm availability and tell you the rental fee and how to pay the deposit.
Once payment is confirmed, pick the dress up in person or receive it by courier.
Return the dress by the date we give you after your event.
We check its condition and refund your deposit.

sections.title: Rental period
body: The standard rental period is 7 days from the day you receive the dress.
To extend, tell us before the return date. Extensions are only possible when no one has booked the dress next, and an extra daily fee applies.

sections.title: Deposit
body: Each dress has its own deposit, shown on its page.
We refund it within 3 business days after we check the returned dress.

sections.title: Cleaning
body: You do not need to wash the dress before returning it. We handle professional cleaning and care.
Please do not machine wash, iron, or remove any decoration, as stones and lace can be damaged.

sections.title: Damage and loss
body: Light wear from skating is fine.
If the dress needs repair, for example lost stones, tears, stains, or loss, the repair cost is deducted from your deposit. If it cannot be repaired, we settle based on the dress's value.

sections.title: Late returns
body: If you return the dress after the due date, a late fee of 20% of the rental fee per day is deducted from your deposit.
If something comes up, please tell us before the return date.

faq.q: What if the size does not fit?
faq.a: Tell us your height and measurements and we will recommend a size. Fittings are available by appointment.

faq.q: Can I get the dress on the morning of the competition?
faq.a: We recommend receiving it 2 to 3 days before. If your schedule is tight, ask us first.
It gets busy in season, so please get in touch at least 2 weeks before your competition.
Please do not alter it yourself. If the length or straps need adjusting, tell us first.

faq.q: Can I return it by courier?
faq.a: Yes. Return shipping is at your cost. Please pack the dress carefully to avoid damage.

faq.q: Do I get a refund if I cancel?
faq.a: If you cancel before receiving the dress, the deposit is fully refunded. The rental fee is refunded only if you cancel at least 3 days before pickup.
